description: This file defines a web page code-behind class 'AdminCourseQueue' for managing an admin interface in an online examination system, handling page events and button clicks to navigate between admin pages and manage course queue interactions.

classes.name: AdminCourseQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for the 'AdminCourseQueue' ASP.NET page, handling page load, navigation buttons, and grid selection events within the admin section of the system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event. Currently does not perform any actions.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the home button, transferring control to the admin panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the profile button. No implementation provided.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the leaderboard button, transferring control to the admin leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the logout button, transferring control to the login page.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles the event when a grid view row is selected, saves the course ID to session, and transfers control to the same page.
